_meta.note: Google Antigravity ACP 1.5.0 cross-process session/load and MCP reload on a second fresh agy_acp_server process over the same isolated GEMINI_HOME. Process 1 ran session/new with loopback stdio probe-one (tool echo_one) and a dummy-key prompt. Process 2 loaded antigravity-session-1 with changed mcpServers (probe-two, tool echo_two); loopback stdio logs confirm Process 2 spawned probe-two with tools/list on session/prompt and never spawned probe-one. Includes cross-cwd session/load success and missing-session -32002 error with host paths replaced by <workspace>, synthetic session ids, one public model, and available_commands_update omitted.
